justifications.goal_fidelity: the commit does exactly what its message says: it removes the uncalled maximum-facets helper and its facet tuple, leaving path_category_gate as the sole production path gate, and it resolves the dead-production-code finding the prior review raised at scorer.py:58. justifications.reuse: the change strengthens the single-source-of-truth property the prior review asked for: the maximum-facets gate no longer persists as a second, uncalled decision path beside the category gate, and no caller has to choose between them. The legacy combined_score/max_composite path in the same module is untouched and would be the next consolidation, but it is outside this commit's scope.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff is a single file and twelve deletions with no additions, no unrelated reformatting and no incidental edits; the out-of-scope test that the change breaks was correctly left untouched and declared as a follow-on rather than edited from outside the grant.
